fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Mechanized hover platoons are among the fastest ground infantry in the TDF, riding hovercraft that can traverse both land and water at speeds that let them cover the vast distances between Taurian population centers. The Concordat has historically favored hovercraft for its armor forces, and that preference extends to mechanized infantry as well.

Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles, giving the platoon a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
